groups.title: 01 · Bramble’s reaction
groups.summary: Separate character and style references. Four original results, inspected rather than silently accepted. Candidate 2 is the strongest expression study; none is final story-ready art.

images.title: Bramble 1
images.notes: Amethyst eye, clovers and angular shading retained. Mouth reads as a grin rather than shared laughter; gaze is up-right rather than down-left.

images.title: Bramble 2
images.notes: Open smile and readable violet eyes; recognizable clovered long-eared hare. Needs down-left eyeline and lavender inner-ear color restored; background has unfinished white areas.

images.title: Bramble 3
images.notes: Blue eye is an identity failure. Closed-mouth expression does not communicate laughter.

images.title: Bramble 4
images.notes: Friendly face with violet eyes and clovers, but closed mouth and upward gaze weaken the intended laughing reaction. Orange inner ears drift from the lavender reference.

groups.title: 02 · Shared play — rejected first pass
groups.summary: The style reference contaminated identity and expression. These are retained as proof of inspection, not offered as finished story art. A targeted correction is in progress.

images.title: Shared play 1
images.notes: Hare has an extra ear-like shape and toothy mouth; fox lacks pink tone. This reads as aggressive, not gentle shared fun.

images.title: Shared play 2
images.notes: Invented backpack and gear on Fox; excessive teeth in both mouths. The shared pose is readable but not compatible with the cast.

images.title: Shared play 3
images.notes: Invented jewelry and equipment; extra marbles and oversized central marble. Smile is too sharp.

images.title: Shared play 4
images.notes: Invented shoulder gear and oversized toothy mouth. Concentration still dominates instead of mutual laughter.

groups.title: 03 · Raze enters
groups.summary: The full-body silhouette and established outfit carry across. Candidate 1 is the best entrance pose; the requested scuff is not yet explicit, and the clearing must be matched.

images.title: Raze 1
images.notes: Readable step, both boots, recognizable mask/muzzle and orange-teal outfit. Needs actual ground scuff and matching clearing; lower-body clothing is a new proposal.

images.title: Raze 2
images.notes: Identity and silhouette hold, but no interruption action. Body proportions differ from candidate 1.

images.title: Raze 3
images.notes: Crouching rather than stepping through the circle. Useful pose reference only; not the planned beat.

images.title: Raze 4
images.notes: Hands-in-pockets stance reads as posing. Marbles too large, geography incomplete.

groups.title: 04 · Shared play — targeted correction
groups.summary: The teeth and equipment are gone, and the faces read more gently. These remain setup studies: action, exact anatomy and eye rendering still need correction.

images.title: Corrected shared play 1
images.notes: Gentle expressions and clear pair; restores lavender ears and clover motif. Extra leafy collar, weak pupils, fur markings and static pose still need correction; marbles are oversized.

images.title: Corrected shared play 2
images.notes: Hare muzzle becomes fox-like and eye blue; Fox acquires clover. Good simplification of shape cannot compensate for wrong identity.

images.title: Corrected shared play 3
images.notes: Readable violet-eyed hare with clovers; friendlier mouths. Eyes too luminous, paws and markings need cleanup; black painted edges need layout review.

images.title: Corrected shared play 4
images.notes: Hare acquires a long fox-like tail. It cannot be used as Bramble despite improved mood.

highlights.title: Corrected shared play 1
highlights.notes: Gentle expressions and clear pair; restores lavender ears and clover motif. Extra leafy collar, weak pupils, fur markings and static pose still need correction; marbles are oversized.

highlights.title: Bramble 2
highlights.notes: Open smile and readable violet eyes; recognizable clovered long-eared hare. Needs down-left eyeline and lavender inner-ear color restored; background has unfinished white areas.

highlights.title: Raze 1
highlights.notes: Readable step, both boots, recognizable mask/muzzle and orange-teal outfit. Needs actual ground scuff and matching clearing; lower-body clothing is a new proposal.
